<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—a dominant peak with a clear M+1 (~20% of M) and progressively smaller M+2, M+3, etc.—the only element whose isotopic distribution can be definitively recognized is carbon (13C contribution). No distinct chlorine, bromine, sulfur, or other element patterns are evident.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
